title: Renewal Desk Note — Renewal, Non-Renewal and Early Exit of Energy Monitoring & Performance Subscriptions
content:
# Renewal, Non-Renewal and Early Exit

Renewal desk note on the term end and exit rules of Energy Monitoring & Performance Subscriptions.

## Rule

The renewal window opens the tier's renewal period before the term end date and the renewal quote carries the escalated fee and the current meter count. Where the tier renews automatically the term renews unless a non-renewal notice was received by the tier's notice deadline, counted back in calendar days from the term end date with the deadline day counting as timely; the top tier does not renew automatically and needs a renewal acceptance on file for this subscription. A customer may cancel early on the tier's written notice period, and the tier's early cancellation rate is applied to the unbilled remainder of the term; a guarantee true-up for a part year is settled at cancellation, prorated by whole months of the year elapsed. On exit the owner receives the full data export where the tier includes it, and the site's interval data is retained for the tier's retention period and then deleted. A subscription closed because onboarding failed carries no cancellation fee. The notice period is counted in calendar days from the day the written notice was received, the notice day excluded and the final day included. The renewal window, the non-renewal notice days, the escalation, the cancellation notice days and the early cancellation rate are the figures fixed for the tier.

## Renewal by tier behaviour

| Tier behaviour | Term renews when |
|---|---|
| renews automatically | no non-renewal notice was received by the deadline |
| does not renew automatically (the top tier) | a renewal acceptance for this subscription is on file in the office's intake records |

The acceptance is read from the intake record for this subscription, not from the call.

## Non-renewal deadline, worked (hypothetical)

Term ends 31 December, notice deadline 60 days: counted back, the deadline day is 1 November, and a notice received on 1 November is timely; a notice received on 2 November is late and the term renews.

## Early cancellation

The notice period runs from the day the written notice was received in the office, as the intake record holds it: the notice day is excluded, calendar days are counted forward, and the final day is included. The early cancellation rate is applied to the unbilled remainder of the term. Where the tier carries a guarantee, the part-year true-up is settled at cancellation, prorated by whole months of the year elapsed.

*Hypothetical:* notice received 3 April with a 30 day period takes effect on 3 May, the thirtieth day.

## Exit

- The full data export is provided where the tier includes it.
- Interval data is retained for the tier's retention period and then deleted.
- A subscription closed because onboarding failed carries no cancellation fee.
